description: Offline biological sequence/music conversion with reversible MIDI, WAV, and MusicXML, accessible score notation, and lossy arbitrary-audio transcription.

defaultPrompt: Turn this FASTA into playable music and a visible score, then turn it back into FASTA to confirm the sequence was preserved.
Recover the sequence from this Seq2Music WAV or MusicXML, return FASTA and a score, and confirm whether recovery is exact.
Turn this WAV into an amino acid sequence, show its score, and explain how the sound was mapped.
interface.longDescription: Seq2Music turns protein, DNA, and RNA sequences into music and score sheets. It can both encode and decode. It can also convert your audio a new protein, DNA, or RNA sequence by matching sounds and notes to sequence letters.

name: seq2music
